Public Sub Setup(ws As Object)
    Dim s As Object
    ws.Range("A1").Value = "text": ws.Range("A2").Value = 2: ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
    Set s = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40): s.Name = "Box": s.TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Boxed"
    Set s = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 120, 10, 100, 40): s.Name = "Note": s.TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Noted"
    Set s = ws.Shapes.AddFormControl(1, 10, 60, 90, 20): s.Name = "Tick": s.ControlFormat.Value = 1: s.ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$C$1"
    Set s = ws.Shapes.AddFormControl(2, 10, 90, 90, 20): s.Name = "Drop": s.ControlFormat.ListFillRange = "$A$1:$A$3": s.ControlFormat.Value = 2
    Set s = ws.Shapes.AddFormControl(6, 10, 120, 90, 50): s.Name = "Pick": s.ControlFormat.ListFillRange = "$A$1:$A$3": s.ControlFormat.Value = 1
    Set s = ws.Shapes.AddFormControl(9, 110, 60, 20, 50): s.Name = "Spin": s.ControlFormat.Value = 3
End Sub
Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "obj " & TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Or IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "Error " & CStr(v)
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
Public Function TypedFontcell(ws As Object, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim o As Excel.Font, v As Variant

    On Error Resume Next

        v = o.Italic

        v = o.Name
    Case 8
        v = o.Size
    Case 9
        v = o.Strikethrough
    Case 10
        v = o.Subscript
    Case 11
        v = o.Superscript
    Case 12
        v = o.ThemeColor
    Case 13
        v = o.ThemeFont
    Case 14
        v = o.TintAndShade

    If Err.Number Then

End Function

        TypedTextFramebox = Show(v)
    End If
End Function

Public Function LateTextFramebox(ws As Object, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim o As Object, v As Variant
    Set o = ws.Shapes("Box").TextFrame
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        v = o.AutoMargins
    Case 1
        v = o.AutoSize
    Case 2
        v = o.Creator
    Case 3
        v = o.HorizontalAlignment
    Case 4
        v = o.HorizontalOverflow
    Case 5
        v = o.MarginBottom
    Case 6
        v = o.MarginLeft
    Case 7
        v = o.MarginRight
    Case 8
        v = o.MarginTop
    Case 9
        v = o.Orientation
    Case 10
        v = o.ReadingOrder
    Case 11
        v = o.VerticalAlignment
    Case 12
        v = o.VerticalOverflow
    End Select
    If Err.Number Then
        LateTextFramebox = "E" & Err.Number
    Else
        LateTextFramebox = Show(v)
    End If
End Function


Public Sub Prepared()
    Setup ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
End Sub

Public Function InModel(ByVal routine As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    InModel = Application.Run(routine, ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1), which)
End Function
